program_source = '''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    horizontal = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    vertical = [c for c in range(width) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(height)}) == 1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in horizontal:
        out[r] = [2] * width
    for c in vertical:
        for r in range(height):
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
program_file.write_text(program_source)
